title: runs.jsonl line
description: One run the person triggered (table runs, docs/spec/20-privacy.md section 5.2): state, trigger kind, times, costs and the numeric metrics. No status line, text excerpt, summary, plan or run step: those are written by the agent and can carry contents of other people of the thread.

thread_id.description: ID of the thread the run belongs to; never its title.

agent_id.description: ID of the agent that ran.

trigger_kind.description: How the person triggered the run.

started_at.description: When the agent started the run.

finished_at.description: When the run reached its end state.

cost_micros.description: Cost of the run in millionths of the currency.

cost_is_estimate.description: Whether the cost is an estimate.

metrics.description: The numeric metrics of the run (schema run_metrics.v1 without the last retry).

context_pct.description: Used share of the context window in percent.

tokens_cache_write.description: Tokens written to the cache with 5 minutes.

tokens_cache_write_1h.description: Tokens written to the cache with 1 hour.

api_retries.description: Number of retried model API calls.

progress_events.description: Number of progress messages of the runtime.
